{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue_float'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove refunded orders
df_final = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_rate_channel = df_final.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

corrected_conv_rate_channel = conv_rate_channel
print("Conversion rate by channel:")
print(corrected_conv_rate_channel)

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conv_rate_segment = df_final.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

corrected_conv_rate_segment = conv_rate_segment
print("\nConversion rate by segment:")
print(corrected_conv_rate_segment)

# Stratify by customer_segment to get a fair comparison
conv_rate_by_channel_segment = df_final.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

corrected_conv_rate_by_channel_segment = conv_rate_by_channel_segment
print("\nConversion rate by channel and segment:")
print(corrected_conv_rate_by_channel_segment)

# Compute the raw difference in conversion rates
raw_diff = corrected_conv_rate_channel['email'] - corrected_conv_rate_channel['paid_search']
print("\nRaw conversion rate difference (email - paid_search):", raw_diff)

# Compute the adjusted difference (within each segment)
segment_sizes = df_final['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

adjusted_diff = 0
for seg in ['new', 'returning', 'loyal']:
    email_conv = corrected_conv_rate_by_channel_segment.loc['email', seg]
    paid_search_conv = corrected_conv_rate_by_channel_segment.loc['paid_search', seg]
    diff_in_seg = email_conv - paid_search_conv
    adjusted_diff += diff_in_seg * segment_sizes[seg]

print("\nAdjusted conversion rate difference (stratified by segment):", adjusted_diff)"}
